description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Inland Revenue Act No. 24 of 2017 Notice under Section 123(8)
reasoning: This gazette notification contains a regulation issued under Section 123(8) of the Inland Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017, as amended. It prescribes specific information requirements that must be shared with the Commissioner General of Inland Revenue. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters - specifically the creation of new regulatory requirements and compliance obligations under existing tax legislation. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail (only listing his title), and the primary focus is on establishing legal requirements rather than government personnel or structural changes.
